name: Ode of Resurrected Wings

desc.0: The wings scorched by the blazing sun once fell to the pale earth, into a lightless chasm.
desc.1: Then fall... She will bear it all. The weight, the darkness, those defiant follies, those lives that slipped away...
desc.2: In that long slumber forgotten by time, even sorrow faded away. Pain and despair faded too... As did joy. As did memory. All withered away, for all is vanity.
desc.3: A hundred years passed in the blink of an eye. Kingdoms upon the earth fell and rose anew, yet she never awoke.
desc.4: But no matter how much unspeakable darkness lay buried within her heart, a bird cannot pretend not to see the coming of spring.
desc.6: "Spring flowers are winter's dream, and autumn clouds remember the summer breeze~"
desc.7: —Beneath the quiet moonlit sky, a pink-haired girl softly hums an ancient nursery rhyme.
